# Tidewell Rowing Club

An invented brand for the test suite. Not a real organisation.

## Colours

- Surface: warm paper `#F4F1EA`; dark surface: deep green `#12372A`.
- Text: deep green `#12372A`; secondary `#4F6B5E`.
- Accent: coral `#E4572E`, one mark per slide.

## Type

The built-in default faces (Inter for PowerPoint).
